toolsPreview.name: rate_hold_deadline
toolsPreview.description: Canada: the last date an offer can be accepted so a mortgage still funds before a rate hold expires. A rate hold applies to the funding date, not the offer date, so the real deadline is weeks before the printed expiry. Requires the expiry date — it cannot be answered without one.
